text:
maya_k: quick note — i pushed a small update to the interviewer handbook (v2) with clarified debrief steps. can we confirm scribe + recording consent for monday's interviews?

samir_patel: i can scribe the 10:30am slot (virtual). please paste the zoom link and any note i should add to the doc.

maya_k: thanks @samir_patel. ops-bot will post the calendar/zoom below. main ask: rubric tweak — should we keep communication at 20% or reduce to 15% and increase problem-solving to 25% for L4+?

aisha: for L3 i lean toward keeping comm 20%. for senior (L4+) we usually up problem solving. i'd say 15/25 split for senior.

elena: +1 to a role-specific baseline. suggestion: default rubric stays 20% comm, but in the invite add a line: "use senior weighting when candidate title >= L4". that keeps consistency.

priya: also — can we remind interviewers to annotate concrete examples in debrief (evidence > impression). quick template: 
```
1) Strengths (2-3 bullets)
2) Weaknesses / risks
3) Score by rubric (with 1 line evidence per dimension)
```

maya_k: perfect, i'll add that template to the handbook intro. @priya can you take lead on the debrief sync reminder email to the panel? short copy only.

priya: yup — i'll send a 24hr reminder and a 1hr 'ready room' ping. draft: "friendly reminder: please join 5 min early, use the template, and mark recording consent in the calendar". ok?

samir_patel: fine with that. one more logistics Q — candidate timezone is PST but calendar shows ET. ops-bot: can you confirm the invite's timezone?

ops-bot: calendar invite updated: start=2025-03-17T10:30:00-08:00 (PST). Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/0000000000. Recording consent: added checkbox to invite.

elena: i'll cover scribe backup if samir gets pulled. thanks all.

maya_k: awesome. final checklist for monday: 1) handbook link in invites ✅ 2) debrief template added ✅ 3) rubric note for senior weighting added ✅ 4) scribe assigned (samir / elena backup) ✅ 5) recording consent on invite ✅

aisha: :thumbsup: good to go.

priya: sending reminders now.

samir_patel: thanks — see you Monday.

ops-bot: Invite: https://calendar.example/evt/6141592653 (updated)
